body:
# Set record constructor mapping flag after publishing the mappings

Assign the record constructor mappings before setting the flag that guards them.

## Description

`ModelMetadata.CalculateRecordTypeConstructorDetails()` is computed lazily without synchronization. It set `_recordTypeConstructorDetailsCalculated = true` *before* assigning `_parameterMapping` and `_boundConstructorPropertyMapping`:

```csharp
_recordTypeConstructorDetailsCalculated = true;
_parameterMapping = parameterMapping;
_boundConstructorPropertyMapping = propertyMapping;
```

If two requests bind the same record type concurrently for the first time, one thread can see the flag set, return early, and read a mapping that is still `null`. `BoundConstructorParameterMapping` / `BoundConstructorPropertyMapping` then return `null` and validation fails with a `NullReferenceException` (e.g. in `DefaultComplexObjectValidationStrategy`). This can happen on x64, because the stores are written in this order in the program.

This change assigns both mappings first and sets the flag last. Unlike the hash code race, this failure is transient: nothing incorrect is cached, so it only affects the requests that hit the window.

This was pointed out by @sterlyagovandrey during the investigation of #59384 ([comment](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/59384#issuecomment-5201927290)). It is separate from the root cause of that issue, which #69888 fixes (the torn `int?` hash code that permanently poisons the parameter mapping). The two changes touch different lines and are independent.

### Notes

- This is intentionally the minimal fix. On weakly ordered architectures (arm64), a reader could in theory still observe the flag before the mappings without a barrier. Making it airtight would mean publishing with `Volatile.Write` and reading the flag with `Volatile.Read`, or dropping the flag and checking `_parameterMapping is not null`. Happy to switch to that if preferred.
- No test added: the race isn't deterministically testable without injecting synchronization points into `ModelMetadata`.

Contributes to #59384
title: Set record constructor mapping flag after publishing the mappings
